text:
Alex CSM: Heads up — MarlinBank renewal is 5 weeks out and we just saw a big drop in activity. Calls down ~78% since Wed. They mentioned a new ML lead (Kai) is running a proof-of-concept with EchoAI. Can we triage?

Priya AE: yikes. Does this line up with any invoice or quota issues? any error spikes?

Marco SE: quick check of their api logs:
```
2026-03-17T14:02:11Z GET /v1/generate 200 rtt=75ms tokens=1,230 user=marlin-prod-key
2026-03-18T09:11:02Z GET /v1/generate 200 rtt=82ms tokens=1,100 user=marlin-prod-key
2026-03-19T00:03:45Z GET /v1/generate 200 rtt=78ms tokens=260 user=marlin-prod-key
2026-03-20T08:22:18Z GET /v1/generate 200 rtt=80ms tokens=45 user=marlin-prod-key
```
Looks like traffic dropped rather than errors. No 4xx/5xx surge.

Tess RevOps: billing side: no failed charges, billing contact confirmed. Their Dedicated pool status is green, autoscaling not triggered.

Nora PM: if their ML lead is experimenting elsewhere, this could be an eval rhythm issue not platform outage. Two quick playbooks: 1) offer a short apples-to-apples perf/cost comparison run with their exact prompts & dataset; 2) run a join session to replay their workload live so we can show latency/cost wins. I can prepare an eval template.

Alex CSM: agree. Prioritize customer contact now — set a 30-min sync with Kai + champion (Laura) to understand objectives. Offer the perf comparison and a one-week Dedicated trial tweak (we can pre-configure quant & batching).

Priya AE: I can take the executive touchpoint. Can someone assemble the comparison numbers (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, estimated per-1M-token cost) for our current recommended config vs EchoAI (if we have public numbers). Marco?

Marco SE: I'll spin up a controlled replay with MarlinBank's latest prompt set. Need their representative request logs (we have partial). I can also produce a quick script they can run locally:
```bash
# replay sample workload against Redwood API
python replay.py --key $MARLIN_KEY --input prompts.json --concurrency 8 --seq-len 512
```
If Kai can't run it, we can host and share results within 48h.

oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance window in us-east-1 on 2026-03-22 02:00-03:30 UTC (read-only ops). No impact expected for MarlinBank Dedicated pool.

Tess RevOps: finance note — MarlinBank signed a PO, commitment active, renewal likely >$250k ARR. We should avoid forcing a procurement re-eval if possible.

Alex CSM: action items: 1) Priya schedule 30-min call w/ Kai + Laura (ASAP this week). 2) Marco produce replay comparison (48h). 3) Nora draft eval template & success criteria. 4) Tess confirm PO status and check legal hold. Add a customer-facing pilot discount (15%) for the trial week? Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Priya AE: 15% sounds reasonable for a time-boxed trial to win back momentum. I'll propose it on the call.

Marco SE: agree. I'll include p50/p95, tokens/sec, and a small-run cost estimate. Also add a short A/B of our quantized model vs their EchoAI baseline if we can infer it.

Nora PM: I'll have the eval template and suggested prompts by EOD tomorrow.

Alex CSM: Great — I'll ping Kai now and post meeting invite when Priya confirms timing. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
